entries.zh: 拆开、拆散（拆解使分离）
entries.en: to break apart, take to pieces; to dismantle, tear open
entries.notes: L 栏连写难辨（疑为 quebrando haciendo 之俗写），据 H「拆」与 M「tia」定义；R 栏残损难辨（T99）降低。

entries.zh: 水道、水渠破裂；水流断绝
entries.en: for the water channels/conduits to break or burst; the waterway to be cut off
entries.notes: 汉字「渇」与西语「水道破裂」义不合，M 栏 fia 亦难佐证，疑字有误录，语义存疑降低。

entries.zh: 摔碎、掷破（掷地打碎；打碎、打破）
entries.en: to break by dashing/throwing down, shatter into pieces

entries.zh: 绳断、断绝（绳线折断而中断）
entries.en: for a rope/cord to break or be severed; (of threads) to snap and come to an end
entries.notes: M、R 栏均有残损，据 L 与 H「绝」及 R 栏残文「hilos, acaban」互证定义。

entries.zh: 掰开、披开（分掰使开）
entries.en: to break open, split apart; to push/spread open
entries.notes: M、R 栏空白，仅据 L/H 二栏，披开义取自汉字。

entries.zh: 捻断（用手指捻折、掐断）
entries.en: to snap/break off between the fingers; to twist off

entries.zh: 叩破、磕破（敲击打裂；亦指用牙咬破坚果）
entries.en: to crack open by knocking/striking; to break (nuts) with the teeth
entries.notes: 西语言用牙破坚果，汉字与 M 栏（ca poà）言叩磕，二据略有出入，并存二义。

entries.zh: 打破（击打使破）
entries.en: to break by a blow; to smash

entries.zh: 打碎（打得粉碎）
entries.en: to break to pieces; to shatter

entries.zh: 砸破、打拆（一击打裂、砸开打散）
entries.en: to break with a heavy blow, smash with one stroke
entries.notes: H「打拆」与西语 porrazo（重击打碎）相合，M 栏 fia chy 两音节义不明，释义以 L/H 为主。

entries.zh: 扒开、掰开（掰分打开，如掰面包）
entries.en: to break open by pulling apart (as a loaf of bread); to split open

entries.zh: 摔碎、捯碎（掷地打碎）
entries.en: to break by throwing/dashing; to shatter to pieces

entries.zh: 食言、失信（失言，说话不算数）
entries.en: to break one's word; to fail to keep one's promise

entries.zh: 食言、失信（「失話」，言而无信）
entries.en: to break one's word/promise

entries.zh: 皱眉、蹙额（琢额，额上纹蹙如刻）
entries.en: to knit one's brows, frown; for the forehead to furrow/wrinkle
entries.notes: 西语头为逐字仿译（额破、眉蹙、额刻），据 H「琢額」判定为皱眉蹙额义。

entries.zh: 断交、绝交（断绝交情）
entries.en: to break off/sunder friendship; to sever friendly relations
entries.notes: H 栏首字徐/除难辨，义据次字「断」与西语「断绝交情」相合。

entries.zh: 断路（断绝往来之路；喻断交，改易旧道）
entries.en: to cut off the road; figuratively, to break off a friendship by changing one's former course

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: H 栏首字残损仅存「不出」，L 栏「破井/壳而不得出」句式义难定夺。

entries.zh: 破敝、损坏（器物敝坏破损）
entries.en: broken, damaged (of a thing); worn-out and broken
entries.notes: H 栏首字敝/敞难辨，据 M 栏（pey huay）与西语「破物」定为敝坏义。

entries.zh: 失船（船破沉没，遭海难失事）
entries.en: for a ship to break/be lost at sea; shipwreck

entries.zh: 捣破、研碎（砧破药料，如捣药）
entries.en: to pound/crush to pieces, as medicinal ingredients on a pounding block
entries.notes: H 栏首字砧/珆难辨，据 M 栏（fiam，砧之音写）与西语「捣药」语境定为砧破义。
